title: CAG → BSUK port manifest
description: Every file that crosses from ~/Downloads/CAG into ~/Downloads/BSUK, and how. This file is the record; scripts/port_from_cag.py applies it; scripts/marker_check.py proves the result. A file that is not in this manifest did not cross.

src.description: Path relative to ~/Downloads/CAG. Never absolute, never containing '..'.

dst.description: Path relative to ~/Downloads/BSUK. Unique across the whole manifest.

mode.description: copy = byte-identical at the same relative path; rename = byte-identical at a new path; rebase = first copy then hand-edited, never overwritten again; deferred = recorded, not written. MODES in scripts/port_from_cag.py is the authority for this enum; keep the two in step.

notes.description: For rebase: what must change. For deferred: which project picks it up. For copy/rename: why it needs no edit.
